newsitem.title: USA: PointCast, China Internet to create Pointcast Asia.
newsitem.headline: PointCast, China Internet to create Pointcast Asia.

text.p: PointCast Inc on Monday said it and Hong Kong-based China Internet Corp plan to form PointCast Asia, a joint venture firm that will create and operate English and Chinese versions of the PointCast Network for the Southeast Asia and Greater China markets.

PointCast's PointCast Network utilizes so-called "push' technology to allow Internet news organizations and entertainment sites to broadcast their programs to specific computer users interested in getting them.
PointCast Asia plans to introduce the English version sometime in mid-1997, with the Chinese version to follow later in the year, the company said.
PointCast Asia will operate a Hong Kong-based broadcast facility, managing content acquisition, advertising sales and marketing throughout Asia.
A Southeast Asia office will also be established in Singapore, PointCast said.
